# Standard-produced state colors

These nine exports were produced by the ordinary
`machinome.core.export.export_node(widget=False)` path from
[`color_project/model.py`](../../../../machinome/tests/color_project/model.py).
The source and tests are part of the same repository; the viewer consumes
their unchanged JSON and real STL files. `receipt.json` records producer
identity, independent native palette expectations and document/model hashes.

`posed`, `powered`, `clocked` and `running` cover each execution kind and an
initially powered driver. `invalid-clocked` places a valid color first and
a non-finite candidate condition later, crossing an event before refusal.
`relation-property` reads an observation settled by the ordinary signal
relations through a color property. Every model uses the authored cube;
no alternative geometry or client-computed lamp observation is delivered.

`clocked-state` selects color from retained state. `publication-safe` and
`publication-unsafe` are two parameterizations of the same authored class,
with identical compiled machine identities and different presentation
conditions; they prove refusal before replacing a live publication.

The browser tests use ordinary controls and public state operations. The
capture tests alias identical manifest bytes under capture's `viewer.json`
staging name. Fixture documents are never patched by those tests.
